SBSLORE.Settings.HideLauncher.Name: Hide Lore Launcher
SBSLORE.Settings.HideLauncher.Hint: Hide the floating banana-slug lore button on this browser. The launcher macro still works.
SBSLORE.Settings.ButtonLocation.Name: Lore Launcher Location
SBSLORE.Settings.ButtonLocation.Hint: Choose where the floating lore button appears on this browser.
SBSLORE.Settings.AllowRetakes.Name: Allow Question Retakes
SBSLORE.Settings.AllowRetakes.Hint: Allow players to answer questions they have already attempted. Every attempt is recorded.
SBSLORE.Settings.ShuffleOptions.Name: Shuffle Answer Options
SBSLORE.Settings.ShuffleOptions.Hint: Randomize the displayed answer order for each player session.
SBSLORE.Settings.QuestionOrder.Name: Question Order
SBSLORE.Settings.QuestionOrder.Hint: Choose whether the bot presents unanswered questions randomly or in their saved order.
SBSLORE.Settings.PlayerLoreAccess.Name: Players Can Browse Lore
SBSLORE.Settings.PlayerLoreAccess.Hint: Allow players to open lore entries from published sets.
SBSLORE.Settings.ShowProgress.Name: Show Player Progress
SBSLORE.Settings.ShowProgress.Hint: Allow players to see their own totals and question history.
SBSLORE.Settings.Manager.Name: Lore Module Manager
SBSLORE.Settings.Manager.Label: Open Lore Manager
SBSLORE.Settings.Manager.Hint: Open the GM interface for lore sets, questions, imports, backups, and player statistics.
